answers.what_it_does: Look up a customer's account tier by email address. Returns their tier level (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) and account ID.

inputs.name: customerEmail
inputs.description: The customer's email address to look up

outputs.name: accountTier
outputs.description: The customer's account tier (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum)

outputs.name: errorMessage
outputs.description: Error message if the lookup failed

answers.data_source: SOQL query on Account object, matching on email field on related Contact
